description: Find the specific hotel rooms that fit a traveler, with the evidence behind each fact. Use this whenever the traveler cares about the room itself: bed, view, bathtub, balcony, accessibility, floor, quiet, Wi-Fi, connecting rooms, kitchenette, pets, blackout, a desk, distance from the elevator, a window that opens. Translate what they say into must_have (deal-breakers) and nice_to_have (wishes). Matches meet every must-have on evidence; 'possible' rooms have a must-have nobody has confirmed and must never be presented as matches. Results are numbered rooms where Roomza holds the hotel's room records, otherwise room types, labeled as such. Then call show_rooms with the matches' room_ids (or the hotel_id for room types), and secure_room to price and book a room the traveler picks.
